description: Monark's branded separator: a 1px flat orange line with an outlined ring at either or both ends, horizontal or vertical. Decorative by default (aria-hidden="true"). With decorative={false} it renders role="separator" with aria-orientation instead.

announcements: decorative={false} - announced as a separator (horizontal or vertical) where the screen reader exposes separators.
screenReader.notes: Most uses sit between landing-page sections that already have their own headings, so the divider adds nothing for screen readers; keep it decorative there.

contrast.ui: The line and rings are the flat orange primary, about 2.3:1 on cream in light mode, below the 3:1 non-text minimum. That is acceptable only because the divider is decorative; do not make it the sole cue that separates content that must be told apart.

consumerResponsibilities: Keep it decorative unless the separation carries meaning; when it does, also separate the content with headings or landmarks.
Give a vertical divider a height through its parent (it stretches to h-full, min 2rem).
Spacing around it (pt-16, my-8) is yours to set via className.
